ATFA solid-timber flatness reference For solid timber flooring, ATFA's specification says that, if no other flatness requirement has been set, slab flatness is not to exceed 3 mm beneath a 3 m straightedge. The selected product's installation instructions may set a different requirement and should still be checked. →
